svg.title: Opportunities and risks of digital platforms
svg.desc: Table of four opportunities and four risks of digital platforms for civic participation. Opportunities: fast and wide reach, low cost, photo and video evidence, and a record of who responded. Risks: misinformation spreads quickly, echo chambers harden views, people without access are excluded, and posts can expose personal data.
svg.text: Opportunities and risks of digital platforms
Opportunities
Risks
Fast and wide reach: a post can
reach a whole town in minutes.
Low cost: a complaint or a campaign
costs very little.
Photo and video evidence: a picture
of a broken drain is hard to deny.
A record of who responded: a portal
shows what the office did.
Misinformation spreads quickly, before
anyone can check it.
Echo chambers harden views: people
hear only what agrees with them.
People without access are excluded:
those offline never see the campaign.
Posts can expose personal data: a
name, photo or address can leak.
Each opportunity carries its own risk.
